title: Town Map Explorer
hook: Build the route from real connections.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D neighborhood storybook, friendly streets and buildings, clean isolated subjects; visual identity: Town Map Explorer

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child planning a town route
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Town Map Explorer a topology lesson: landmarks, routes, crossings, transit nodes, services and destinations form a network; map order is spatial, not alphabet order.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child builds a route with connections—bus stop to road to crossing to destination—then checks whether X-ray Clinic, University, Park, and services fit the route.
